name: Lieke Vermeer
bio: Lieke's motorsport journey began unconventionally, not on the track, but in her family's transport business. Managing complex logistics for heavy machinery sparked her interest in optimizing processes. She transitioned to motorsport, initially handling parts and equipment movement for a small racing team. Her knack for anticipating logistical bottlenecks and implementing innovative solutions quickly earned her recognition. Lieke believes in a data-driven approach to logistics, emphasizing predictive analysis and proactive problem-solving to ensure seamless operation. Her meticulous planning and ability to remain calm under pressure are her distinguishing features.

physical.description: Lieke has a focused look with a slight build and an aura of quiet determination.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with logistical flowcharts.
Insists on a pre-race organizational checklist, no matter how familiar the event.
Has a peculiar fondness for labeling everything with an industrial label maker.
